By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 816/2023 dated 13.12.2023, registered at Police Station Bindapur, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, on the ground of a settlement arrived at between the parties.
2. Issue notice.
Mr. Hitesh Vali, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Notice be served upon respondent No. 2 by all permissible modes, including through the Investigating Officer.

3. Although it is the case of the petitioners that respondent No. 2 has not come forward to cooperate in the quashing of the said FIR, despite having taken the benefit of the settlement between the parties, paragraph 19 of the petition reads as follows:
